input_text: Alex is being sued for breach of contract relating to a delay in the shipment of mangos. To prove that the shipment was delayed, a witness for the plaintiffs testifies that he heard Alex complain about not being able to deliver the mangos in time.

extraction.input_text: Alex is being sued for breach of contract relating to a delay in the shipment of mangos. To prove that the shipment was delayed, a witness for the plaintiffs testifies that he heard Alex complain about not being able to deliver the mangos in time.

claim.text: Is the statement described in this narrative hearsay under FRE 801(c)?

arguments.text: The statement was made out of court, as Alex's complaint occurred prior to the trial testimony.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(a) - A 'statement' is an oral or written assertion or nonverbal conduct of a person, if it is intended by him as an assertion.
arguments.evidence_span: a witness for the plaintiffs testifies that he heard Alex complain

arguments.text: Alex's complaint constitutes an assertion of fact regarding his inability to deliver the mangos on time.
arguments.evidence_span: Alex complain about not being able to deliver the mangos in time

arguments.text: The statement is offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted, specifically that the shipment was delayed.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) - Hearsay is a statement that the proponent offers in evidence to prove the truth of the matter asserted in the statement.
arguments.evidence_span: To prove that the shipment was delayed, a witness for the plaintiffs testifies

arguments.text: The statement qualifies as a party-opponent admission under FRE 801(d)(2), which excludes it from the definition of hearsay.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(d)(2)(A) - A statement is not hearsay if it is offered against an opposing party and was made by the party in an individual or representative capacity.
arguments.evidence_span: Alex is being sued... witness for the plaintiffs testifies that he heard Alex complain
